_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Ship Test Outline
summary: A Ship Test Outline defines a specific test requirement, states the test purpose and method, and provides guidance for developing ship test procedures.
description_purpose: A ship test outline defines a specific test requirement and briefly states the test purpose and method. The test outline allows scoping of test effort and provides guidance for development of the test procedures.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) describes data required by 5.2.8 of DOD-STD-2106(NAVY).

7.2 Related Data Item Descriptions are:
DI-QCIC-80204, Test Elements List
DI-QCIC-80206, Shipboard Industrial Test Procedure

7.3 This DID supersedes DI-T-26251A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Source document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date, and dates of any applicable amendments and revisions shall be reflected in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Format and content of the ship test outline shall be in accordance with Appendix B of DOD-STD-2106(NAVY).

preparation_instructions.title: Preparation.
preparation_instructions.content: The test outline shall be prepared on white 20-pound bond paper or equivalent of 8 1/2 by 11-inch size. When more than one page per test outline is required, the binding shall be a staple in the upper left-hand corner. Only one side of the paper shall be used. Electrostatic methods of reproduction may be used. Where a standard abbreviation, acronym, or symbol does not exist, the full word or phrase shall be used to avoid ambiguity.
